brand.name: glowa
brand.madeIn: Built in Bulgaria, for the world

home.subtitle: Glowa is the modern platform for online booking, salon management and happier clients — all in one place.

foundation.title: Your clients stay yours
foundation.body: No commission on bookings. No fee for a client who was already yours. Export your data whenever you want. Bulgarian, English and Romanian — and every client is messaged in their own language.

features.title: Built for the people who make
features.subtitle: Glowa gives you the tools to run, organise and grow your business — simply and effectively.

booking.title: Online booking
booking.body: Clients book around the clock, with no phone tag and no waiting.

payments.title: Payments

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. Booking through Glowa is free for the client. Only the business pays, for its team.
faq.q2: What happens to my data if I leave?
faq.a2: It stays yours. You can export your clients and bookings at any time, and closing the account does not mean we keep your content.
faq.q3: Do you take a percentage of revenue?
faq.a3: No. The subscription is flat. If you switch on online payments, the fee belongs to the payment provider, not to us.
faq.q4: What languages does the platform work in?
faq.a4: Bulgarian, English and Romanian, for both the business and the client. Each client is messaged in their own language.
faq.a5: Yes, at any time. The change applies from the next billing period.
